findings.current:
“Was it fun being the only one shoving pills down your throat?”

“What?”

“I asked if it was fun shoving pills down your throat all by yourself.”
findings.defect: The repeated exchange is rephrased across the chapter boundary, creating an audible continuity jump and changing Taekyung’s established wording.
findings.rationale: Using the exact dialogue from Chapter 117 makes the overlapping scene continuous and preserves the punchline that motivates Taekyung’s own pill use.
findings.replacement:
“Did you enjoy being the only one popping pills?”

“What?”

“I asked if you enjoyed taking pills all by yourself.”
findings.source: Chapter 118, opening dialogue repeated from Chapter 117

summary: The packet preserves the established action-comedy voice and most continuity, but it contains two binding terminology errors, one character-name substitution, inconsistent repeated dialogue, several formatting defects, and four state/summary entries that overlook the death immediately before the final charge and therefore overcount the last-stand participants.
